summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that defines a service called 'memos' using the neosmemo/memos image. It sets up a container that listens on port 5230, persists data to a local directory, and automatically restarts if it crashes.

explanations.1: This is a special comment syntax that tells certain documentation tools (like Docusaurus) to highlight the next line visually.
explanations.8: Setting init to true ensures that the container properly handles signals like SIGTERM, which helps it shut down cleanly.
explanations.10: This maps port 5230 on your computer to port 5230 inside the container, so you can access the memos service via localhost:5230.
explanations.12: This creates a named volume that stores the memos data from inside the container (/var/opt/memos) to a folder called 'data' on your computer, so the data persists even if the container is deleted.
explanations.13: This tells Docker to automatically restart the container if it crashes, unless you manually stop it.
